work.author: John Chrysostom
work.description: Chrysostom's continuous commentary on the Epistle to the Galatians, in six parts following the letter's six chapters. It is conventionally cited by the chapter of Galatians commented on, and English editions print it in six sections titled by chapter. The appointed Epistle of the Fifteenth Sunday after Pentecost, Gal. 5:25-6:10, falls across the ends of chapters 5 and 6.
work.title: Hypomnema eis ten pros Galatas epistolen: Commentarius in epistulam ad Galatas
